models.mechanism: Recurring time functions as a press: successive intervals compress what occurs within them until a residue or yield becomes manifest.

activation_trace.assigned_role: casts succession as the pressure that forces hidden contents outward
names the product disclosed by temporal pressure

structural_cues: The revealed text is an isolated oath phrase, wāw plus the definite noun al-ʿaṣr, so its single root image carries all foregrounded interpretive weight.
Only one root occurs and no pressure-to-yield sequence is grammatically stated; the linkage is a same-root overlay rather than an expressed event chain.

abductive_moves.assumption: The dormant pressing and yield branches may color the directly available time branch.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: They turn three branches of one root into a causal mechanism rather than an unrelated sense list.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: recurring time → compression of events → extracted yield or residue
alternatives: The oath invokes chronological time without a pressure image.
The extracted result could be depletion rather than gain.

changed_reading.before: An oath by recurring or passing time.
changed_reading.after: An oath by time as a press that makes the otherwise hidden yield of events come out.

models.ablation: Removing B002 collapses the press mechanism into a generic oath by time; removing B007 preserves pressure but loses the specific notion of an extracted product.

models.mechanism: A temporal phase acts like a protective enclosure in which latent life reaches a threshold of maturity; time is a chamber of formation, not merely a stream.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: age, recurring time, and named phases of day
activation_trace.assigned_role: provides the bounded interval of development
models the interval as a sheath that contains and protects what is forming
supplies the transition from latency to attained maturity

structural_cues: The definite singular al-ʿaṣr presents one named temporal phase as the object of the oath.
There is no expressed subject undergoing development and no explicit before-after sequence, so enclosure and maturation remain dormant same-root possibilities.

abductive_moves.assumption: A bounded interval can be assigned the role of an incubating sheath whose duration enables maturation.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: This causally connects the temporal, enclosed-grain, and maturity branches without claiming that the one-word phrase states the process.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: bounded temporal enclosure → protected development → threshold maturity
alternatives: The phase merely marks clock time.
Enclosure could signify restraint rather than nurture.

changed_reading.before: An oath by a time or age.
changed_reading.after: An oath by the formative interval that holds latent things until they ripen into a new state.

models.ablation: Removing B010 makes the reading generic maturation over time; removing B009 leaves only static temporal enclosure and eliminates the developmental outcome.

surprise_reading: At this focus-only baseline, al-ʿaṣr may provisionally evoke time as a press that extracts the hidden yield of events; a weaker alternative hears it as a containing interval in which what is latent ripens.
